name: Masturbation
overview: Scripture addresses the issue of sexual purity by emphasizing the importance of controlling lustful desires and avoiding acts that defile the body. Leviticus 15:16 highlights the physical uncleanness associated with the emission of semen, while Jesus teaches in Matthew 5:28 that lustful thoughts equate to adultery in the heart. Believers are called to put on Christ and resist fulfilling the lusts of the flesh (Romans 13:14), recognizing that works of the flesh include uncleanness and lasciviousness (Galatians 5:19). Temptation arises from one’s own lust, not from God (James 1:13-14), underscoring personal responsibility in pursuing holiness.
